criteria.standard: Normal coding, debugging, writing, analysis, routine research, and evidence gathering.
criteria.frontier: Architecture, hard debugging, broad refactors, consequential decisions, and every review.

kinds.description: Illustrative defaults, set from one B.1 run (M3 Max, clef-flash, 20 guidance queries, load-confounded): 16 candidates of 800 bytes; arm choice because it measured 2 to 3 times faster than ladder (cold p95 4.5 to 11.6 s against 12.8 to 21.7 s), 120 of 120 replies valid; budgetMs 5000 because a detached shadow call keeps the CLI process alive up to that budget, so with these latencies many shadow calls end as timeout misses on this machine; gate.latency.p95CapMs.rerank stays 3000 and is expected to fail here.
kinds.instructions: Select the candidate that best answers the query.

scoreLadder.instructions: Rate how well candidate <label> answers the query, using only the fields for that label.
criteria: The candidate is unrelated to the query.
The candidate shares the topic but does not help answer the query.
The candidate answers part of the query or only one aspect of it.
The candidate answers the query but leaves out detail or needs other passages.
The candidate answers the query fully on its own.
